text: Yes, tree-cover loss occurred on this property in 2022. Approximately 0.6 hectares (3.41% of the asset) of native forest were affected, as detected by Hansen GFC data. The JRC 2020 reference map confirms the area was forested before the event. However, this evidence alone does not confirm deforestation or land-use change, as the loss could result from natural causes (e.g., fire, storms) or forestry activities (e.g., harvesting). The change was not legally evaluated, and its legality or responsibility remains undetermined.
